name: Otherworldly Familiar

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Reference-only: When casting Find Familiar, choose Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder Resistance for it until recast. It may pass through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; ending a turn inside an object moves it to its last empty space.
